about_the_game:
The poignant yet beautiful tones of The Cage –

This album captures the essence of a new NieR world, brought to life once again by the iconic duo—Creative Director Taro Yoko and Composer Keiichi Okabe.

Packed with must-listen tracks for series fans, the album features evocative field BGM that paints a desolate yet stunning landscape, as well as poignant and beautiful story BGM from the "storybook" segments—all compiled into the album.

Immerse yourself in the ever-expanding world of NieR through this stunning soundtrack.

*NieR Re[in]carnation was the first mobile title in the NieR series, released in February 2021. (The service has since been discontinued.)
